title: Add getEnergySnapshot query method to equipa canister

requirements.text: Add a `getEnergySnapshot` query method to the equipa canister (backend/main.mo or the equipa canister source) that aggregates all cached device data and returns a record containing: total power (sum of all cached device power values), active device count (number of devices with cached data), average carbon intensity (average of all cached carbon values), current cycle cost (from the existing cycleCost state variable), and a timestamp (current time or latest cached timestamp).

quotes: Just confirm and I'll generate the updated equipa code with that method included.
generate the updated equipa code with that method included.

acceptanceCriteria: The method is declared as a `query` function named `getEnergySnapshot`.
It returns a record with fields: totalPower (Float), activeDevices (Nat), averageCarbon (Float), cycleCost (Nat), and timestamp (Int).
When no devices are cached, totalPower = 0.0, activeDevices = 0, averageCarbon = 0.0, and cycleCost reflects the current stored value.
When devices are cached, totalPower is the sum of all cached device power fields, activeDevices is the count of cached entries, and averageCarbon is the arithmetic mean of all cached carbon fields.
`dfx canister call --query equipa getEnergySnapshot` returns successfully without IC0536 error after redeployment.
Existing methods (listDevices, registerDevice, fetchDeviceData, getCachedData, getAllCachedData, setCycleCost, getCycleCost, resetCycleCost) remain unchanged and functional.

constraints: All logic must remain in the single equipa canister Motoko actor — do not create new canisters or files.
Do not alter the existing data structures or state variables beyond what is needed to support getEnergySnapshot.
Do not break any existing exported methods.
nonGoals: Persistent snapshot storage — this is a computed query only.
